technical.summary: Short-term momentum is bullish with RSI and moving average confluence, but intermediate trend weakness (below 50-day MA, below cloud, low ADX) and negative volume signals limit conviction for a high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: No actionable signals detected across insider, institutional, government, lobbying, or retail channels; earnings in 39 days presents material risk with minimal conviction support.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (VIX-equivalent 20) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional conviction and absent news data limit conviction; mixed signals warrant caution.

risk.summary: Extreme macro stress: inverted yield curve signals recession, VIX at crisis levels (336), strong dollar headwind, CPI event today, and credit deterioration create hostile environment for Health Care equities despite 39-day earnings buffer.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term momentum (RSI 9 bullish, SMA 9/21 confluence, Supertrend bullish) with extreme fear sentiment (VIX crisis) creates contrarian entry opportunity near support at 121.74.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro environment is hostile (inverted yield curve, VIX 336, strong dollar, CPI event today) with price below 50-day MA and cloud, negative volume (CMF, OBV), low ADX, and high earnings risk in 39 days—fundamentals and intermediate trend offer zero conviction support.

decision.entry_rationale: Short-term momentum (RSI 9, SMA 9/21 bullish) and extreme fear sentiment offer contrarian appeal at support. However, macro hostility (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, CPI event today) and intermediate trend weakness (below 50-MA, below cloud, negative volume) create asymmetric risk that outweighs momentum setup.
decision.primary_risk: Inverted yield curve + VIX crisis + CPI event today create macro shock risk; 39-day earnings proximity with zero fundamental conviction amplifies downside exposure in high-volatility Health Care sector.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical bullish but fundamentals, risk, and debate all strongly bearish; sentiment contrarian but weak conviction
